The bug was in `bugfix/stats.js`, where the mean was being calculated by dividing the sum by `a.length + 1` instead of `a.length`.

I fixed it by changing the line to:
`exports.mean = (a) => a.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / a.length;`

```bash
node --test
```

✔ mean of one (0.1488ms)
